duplicate_search.scope: SeedAtlasFinitePP and its ten transitive consumers in the current effective selection. This search is scoped to the selected source packets.
duplicate_search.result: Among the selected owners, fallback already states the signed sum and actual_fallback_errors pays the coprime and small-prime terms. None of these owners supplies this actual-Entry A=3 payment. The earlier compact rank-two, cap-N estimate and generic finite-carrier results have different hypotheses and carriers.

normalization.scope: C >= 0, natural A >= 3, tolerance > 0, and eventual N >= 2 with normalized payment.

theorems.name: actual_signed_errors_of_entry_A3
theorems.scope: Geometry n/root/tau/mesh/h is fixed before N. The hypothesis gives a nonnegative C_v and an eventual bound along even N per finite Entry v with its own rank, the full 2*N tuple weight, and common Q(N), R(N). Finite intersection and B=sum_v mark_v*C_v give the tolerance bound on the absolute marked signed sum. The modulus sum remains signed. Zero constants and an empty finite type cause no division.

theorems.name: actual_signed_errors_of_uniformPP
theorems.scope: Assumes the existing UniformPrimeProductTarget for every actual entry with index Unit, cap 2*N, identical Q/R and full actualWeight. Specializing real A=3 yields the positive constant, threshold, and even-N bound. The budget uses its natural exponent form.

theorems.name: actual_all_errors_of_entry_A3
theorems.scope: For fixed bank/grid parameters, moving L(N), and explicit eventual active support of rho, one half tolerance for the signed aggregate combines with one half tolerance for the old coprime plus small-prime payment. The identical actual moduli, rho and complete 2*N weight occur in all three terms.

open_boundaries: Actual per-entry signed A=3 analytic estimate and the stronger UniformPrimeProductTarget remain hypotheses.
The active-support condition is explicit. The result does not prove Fine density, a P3 licence, a target-dependent-geometry uniformity statement, a full upper-count comparison, or the P2.9 endpoint.
